{{RaceIcon|Gnome|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Gnome|Female}} [[Gnome]] | capital = [[Dalaran]] | government = Magocracy | language = [[Common (language)|Common]] | affiliation = [[Alliance]] | faffiliation = [[Alliance of Lordaeron]], [[Arathor|Empire of Arathor]] | status = Crippled | tabard = Dalaran Tabard.jpg }} '''Dalaran''' (officially the '''Magocracy of Dalaran''',''[[Of Blood and Honor]]'' and also referred to as the '''City State of Dalaran''')[[Magus Orelius#Quotes]] is one of the [[Seven Kingdoms|seven human nations]] in the [[Eastern Kingdoms]], located near the southern coast of [[Lordamere Lake]] in Lordaeron. It is a small, magocratic nation originally founded as a city-state by magi of the Empire of Arathor. It is ruled by the [[Kirin Tor]], an elite cadre of the most powerful wizards in the known world, under the leadership of the [[Council of Six]]. ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Human nations]]
